title: The Return Of Gloss, Direct From Italy
bodyHtml:
Gloss Reimagined

Studio Bagno redefines the role of gloss within the contemporary bathroom.

Our latest collection of Italian-made gloss finishes introduces colour and vibrancy — transforming surfaces into sculptural elements that engage with light and space.

Explore our New Gloss Colour Arrivals


Futura Vortex Flush in Gloss Colours

A Bold New Statement

Curated from Italy’s leading design fairs, the new gloss colour palette reflects a renewed European sensibility — expressive, tactile, and distinctly modern.

Each tone has been selected to complement both minimalist and material-rich interiors, adding a luminous layer of sophistication to any design language.


Shard X 50 in Gloss Petrol

Form Elevated

From the crisp geometry of Shard X to the soft, organic lines of Hyde, the latest gloss finishes enhance every contour with architectural precision.

The Idilla series gains new depth in gloss, its sculptural curves elevated by light and reflection, while Nur embodies contemporary elegance — defined by graceful ease and form.


Idilla Oval in Gloss Myrtle

Refined Aesthetics

Our gloss finishes now extend across Futura Colour Pans, marrying advanced hydraulics with refined Italian aesthetics. The result is a seamless union of performance and visual elegance — functional pieces transformed into architectural features that exemplify Studio Bagno’s commitment to pushing the boundaries of design and technical innovation.

Excitingly, the Monolith Vortex Flush is in final development — promising a next-level convergence of sculptural form, technical precision, and high-gloss sophistication.


Monolith Vortex Flush in Gloss Grey

The Language of Light

Each finish in this collection is crafted to explore how light defines form, creating depth, contrast, and a heightened sense of visual clarity within the bathroom environment.


Futura Vortex Flush in Gloss Colours
